project.title: SSC - Cloud Platform Engineering / Hosting Services Branch
project.role: AWS Cloud Infrastructure as Code DevOps Engineer & Architect

role_overview.summary: Shared Services Canada's Hosting Services Branch Cloud Platform Engineering team delivers and operates an enterprise-class AWS cloud tenancy supporting multiple Government of Canada departments through AWS Secure Environment Accelerator (ASEA) and Landing Zone Accelerator (LZA) platforms. Christian serves as AWS Cloud Infrastructure as Code DevOps Engineer and Architect through Ottawa Cloud Consulting, operating across two concurrent workstreams — the platform engineering track responsible for Kubernetes/EKS GitOps architecture and IaC standards, and the automation and orchestration framework track responsible for multi-account AWS Organizations governance, serverless and event-driven workload design, EKS cluster engineering, and developer Golden Path tooling. This is the current active engagement as of 2026.

challenge.summary: SSC's Hosting Services Branch required delivery of an enterprise-class, multi-department AWS cloud tenancy across two concurrent engineering workstreams — a Kubernetes/EKS GitOps platform and a cloud automation and orchestration framework — meeting Security By Design requirements aligned to NIST 800-53 and ITSG controls, at a scale (200+ workloads, multiple GoC departments) with no existing EKS or GitOps baseline in place at engagement start.

solution.summary: Delivered comprehensive cloud and infrastructure solutions across:
deliverables: Cloud Services Directorate, Cloud Platform Engineering
Cloud Services Directorate, Automation and Orchestration Framework

outcomes: ✅ Successfully architected and deployed enterprise-class GitOps platform serving multiple government departments through AWS EKS and ArgoCD
✅ Established Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform and Crossplane, enabling rapid deployment of NIST 800-53 compliant workloads across SSC's AWS Landing Zone Accelerator platform
✅ Architected 3 multi-account AWS organizations managing 200+ workloads with governance, SCPs, identity models, and compliance baselines aligned to NIST, CIS, and ITSG
✅ Improved deployment frequency by 30% through GitOps automation with ArgoCD and Azure DevOps, managing over 50 microservices
✅ Designed 30+ serverless, event-driven, and containerized workloads reducing operational overhead by 40% and infrastructure costs by $25K annually
✅ Engineered 3 production EKS clusters achieving 99.9% uptime while reducing Kubernetes onboarding time by over 60% through deterministic automation and developer Golden Paths
